description: CMHC (mortgage default insurance) premium for any down payment under 20% on a Canadian home: premium rate and amount added to the mortgage, provincial sales tax on the premium (ON, QC, SK — paid in cash at closing), and the insured mortgage total.

closingDate.description: Closing date YYYY-MM-DD; sets Quebec's premium tax (9% to 2026-12-31, 9.975% after). Default: today

firstTimeBuyerNewBuild.description: true if first-time buyer OR newly built home (insured 30-year amortization may apply)

province.description: Province, for sales tax on the premium
